inputs.locator: Decision feature: DAILY_DOWNSIDE_SEMIVARIANCE_SHARE_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN. For each complete UTC day, sum squared negative hourly close-to-close returns and divide by the sum of all squared hourly close-to-close returns; divide that share by the median of exactly the prior 20 complete-day shares. At the unchanged DRA decision, admit only when the ratio is at or below the frozen threshold. No incomplete day, later bar, total-volatility substitution, sign change, alternate lookback or threshold search is permitted.

Frozen variants and accounting: lower neighbor 0.8, primary 1.0 and upper neighbor 1.2; Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and annual folds 2020-2024. Parent and every variant use 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity, eight 30-USDT lots, 0.10 percent fee each side, 0.05 percent adverse slippage each side, next-open fills, unchanged DRA seven-day cooldown and profit-only exits.

Frozen gate set: require exact corpus and parent parity; primary Design and Validation total PnL strictly higher; Validation realized and unrealized non-worse; Validation drawdown delta at most +0.25pp; median and P90 holding non-worse; at least four Validation interventions; at least 3/5 annual total-PnL wins and 4/5 annual drawdown non-worse; positive annual delta concentration at most 60 percent; both neighbors improve Validation total PnL, stay within drawdown tolerance and have adequate support. Every gate must pass.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen downside-semivariance DRA V1 entry-admission mechanism on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the unchanged equal-capital parent with primary 1.0 and the already frozen 0.8/1.2 stability neighbors. The decision feature uses only the latest complete UTC day's share of squared negative hourly returns in total squared hourly returns, divided by the prior 20-complete-day median. Retain one prior for a separately frozen hypothesis only if Design, Validation, annual breadth, contribution concentration, drawdown, holding, underwater duration, utilization, realized/unrealized PnL and terminal inventory pass the unchanged declarative gate set; otherwise close the family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not clean OOS, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization.
stop_conditions: Before corpus or outcome access, validate the exact task, dispatch, pre-dispatch intent and strategy path; re-hash every non-null input and require a clean branch whose HEAD equals its matching origin. Any mismatch is DRA_DOWNSIDE_SEMIVARIANCE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT with no partial conclusion.
Read only the listed repository files, task messages and exact sealed TSV. Do not inspect another research artifact, current server state, post-2024 bar, forward outcome or OOS.

Require sealed corpus SHA-256 e436a5a2b093365886464dd3e471cc5cd55c54bd2c06ceaa898ac218c45436dd, exactly 52,608 rows, finite valid OHLCV, exact one-hour continuity and coverage from 2019-01-01 through 2025-01-01. Do not repair a failure.
Require the committed declarative, equal-capital and base DRA runners at their frozen task hashes. Import and run them without editing, monkey-patching, wrapping or changing economics.
Use exactly the unchanged parent and three frozen downside-share variants 0.8, 1.0 and 1.2. Do not run another threshold, lookback, formula, sign relation, estimator, regime, side, size or filter.

Compute hourly close-to-close returns without using a later bar. For each complete UTC day divide negative-return squared variation by total squared variation, then compare that share with the median of exactly the prior 20 complete-day shares. A zero denominator or missing prior window fails closed and is counted.
Keep Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and calendar folds 2020 through 2024 fixed. Historical Validation is development evidence, not clean OOS.
Before reading variant results, require the unchanged parent to reproduce every frozen runner parity checkpoint. A mismatch is the insufficient-evidence disposition.

For parent and every variant report realized, unrealized and total PnL, maximum drawdown, average and peak utilization, buys, sells, open lots, blocked entries, turnover, median and P90 completed holding, underwater hours and maximum duration, terminal inventory, parent signals, admissions, vetoes and unavailable features.
Compute paired deltas only within the same 250-USDT-equity and 240-USDT-capacity window. Do not compare absolute PnL with a different capital, parent, strategy or accounting boundary.

Apply only DRA_DECLARATIVE_ENTRY_ADMISSION_GATES_V1. Return the retain disposition only if data, source, parity, accounting, primary Design and Validation, annual breadth, concentration, holding, path-risk and both-neighbor gates all pass.

Return DRA_DOWNSIDE_SEMIVARIANCE_BRANCH_CLOSE when valid paired evidence fails one or more frozen positive gates. Close the exact downside-semivariance-share entry-admission family without tuning or a nearby feature.

Return DRA_DOWNSIDE_SEMIVARIANCE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT for any input, source, data, parity, arithmetic, feature-accounting or required-field failure. Do not partially classify a window or request permission.
A retained prior permits at most one separately frozen future hypothesis with untouched evidence boundaries. It is not alpha, a candidate, OOS, a runtime filter, deployment or Trading authorization.

A valid close is a useful terminal mechanism conclusion. Do not reopen it through a different downside-share threshold, semivariance lookback, hourly sign convention, selected year, gate tolerance, total-volatility interaction or reporting change.

Write only one create-only artifact at .research-state/experiments/dra-downside-semivariance-entry-admission-v1/artifacts/screen.json. Do not write another repository, research-state, canonical, server, inbox, outbox, schedule or external path. Return one schema-valid local-research-result with all safety assertions false.

Stop without permission if an action would require an unlisted file, dependency, network, server call, post-2024 evidence, outcome-dependent change, OOS, candidate action or Trading action. Preserve exact missing proof.
